messages:
Kevin: Quick heads-up — shipping window needs to move by ~4 hours. Build timing bumped due to a CI flake on quant tests. Not a blocker but want extra validation before announcing.
Maria: OK, does that change the public ETA for #announcements?
Kevin: Yes, hold off on the blast. New tentative ETA is +4h from original. I can post a slip notice if we lock it.
Sara: What do we need to validate in those 4h? Is it just the quant CI or any e2e smoke?
Ash: The quant CI had a nondeterministic failure on CUDA kernel selection. I triggered a rerun; if it passes twice we'll be comfortable. Also want a quick latency smoke on staging (20k tokens/s sample).
Jason: I can run a rolling canary on one dedicated pool once Ash confirms green. If anything odd, we stop and rollback to previous model pin.
Maria: Can we prepare the #announcements copy now with the updated ETA and the reason (brief)? I'll hold publish until you give the thumbs-up.
Kevin: Draft for approval: "Ship update delayed ~4h for extra validation of inference kernels; canary will run after green CI. We'll update again when canary finishes." Thoughts?
Sara: Sounds good. Maybe add a one-liner about rollback plan: "If canary shows regressions, we'll rollback to v2026.03.16 and notify."
Ash: +1 to the rollback line. Also include who to contact for on-call: @Jason for infra, @Kevin for release.
Kevin: Updated draft: "Delay ~4h to validate inference kernel fixes. Canary will run; if regressions seen we'll rollback to v2026.03.16. Contact @Jason (infra) or @Kevin (release)." Maria, you happy to queue that?
Maria: Yup I'll queue it but won't post until Kevin posts a green. I'll also tag #product for visibility.
release-bot: CI rerun started for quant-tests (job 54321) — monitoring.
Ash: CI passed twice. Pushing latency smoke now (`./infra/tests/latency_sample.sh --staging`).
Jason: Latency smoke looks flat vs baseline — no regressions in 5m window. Kicking off canary on pool-gamma.
release-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-id gamma-2026-03-17-01. Health checks: 0 failing.
Kevin: Canary healthy at 10m. Rolling to full candidate. Maria, feel free to post the announcement now with the updated ETA note and rollback line.
Maria: Posted to #announcements and cross-posted to #eng-releases. Copy: "Ship update delayed ~4h for kernel validation; canary passed and candidate rolling. Contact @Jason or @Kevin for questions." Added :thumbsup: reaction.
Ash: Thanks all — keeping an eye on telemetry for the next 30m.
Jason: I'll keep the rollback playbook ready. If anyone spots regressions, ping `#eng-oncall` and tag me.
Kevin: Closing the loop here. No further action unless we see anomalies. Great coordination, team. :tada:
